title: Controlled tomato greenhouse temperature experiment
abstract: In this synthetic greenhouse experiment, tomato plants exposed to 12 degrees Celsius developed fewer fruits than those grown at 22 degrees Celsius.
Across four simulated trials, the lower-temperature group had reduced tomato fruit yield.
The experiment does not establish outcomes for other crops.

title: Synthetic urban tree canopy field study
abstract: Simulated observations found that streets with greater tree canopy coverage had lower daytime surface temperatures.
This synthetic correlation does not establish that every individual tree causes an equal cooling effect.

title: Synthetic battery cycle research
abstract: In a laboratory simulation, lithium battery cells charged continuously at elevated temperature lost capacity faster than cells charged at moderate temperature.
The simulation compared 45 degrees Celsius against 25 degrees Celsius over 300 charge cycles.

title: Synthetic coastal rainfall analysis
abstract: Over the artificial observation period, coastal stations received more winter rainfall than inland stations.
The artificial rainfall measurements are not generalizable to real geographic regions.

title: Synthetic indoor air circulation evaluation
abstract: In the simulated office, increasing ventilation rate decreased the concentration of a harmless tracer gas.
The synthetic experiment did not measure transmission of any infectious disease.
